versions.changelog:
Initial release — enables discovery and vetting of US AI/ML/data consulting firms.

- Find, shortlist, and enrich US-based AI/ML/data consultancies for projects like LLM apps, recommendation engines, MLOps, and analytics.
- Automatically applies catalog taxonomy for AI consultancies using the ServiceGraph API.
- Excludes individual freelancers, non-US firms, general software/web development, AI tool comparisons, and in-house hiring.
- Enforces credit model: brief firm data is free; full contact details/unlocks require credits.
- Guides proper API key management, filtering, and usage to ensure secure and accurate results.
